description: LAA, 2005 June regular phase: 51 of 51 selections from MLB's draft feed (historical importer).

coverage_claims.gap_notes: MLB's draft feed lists 51 selection(s) for the club in the June regular phase. Independent count: 51 (Baseball-Reference franchise-year page, Internet Archive capture 20241130103848: 51 listed, 51 matched to MLB's picks by name (6 by surname in the same round: #253 MLB "Matthew Hall" / "Matt Hall"; #283 MLB "Bobby Mosebach" / "Robert Mosebach"; #373 MLB "Gregory Dini" / "Greg Dini"; #433 MLB "Stephen Brock" / "Steven Brock"; #883 MLB "Vincent Scarduzio" / "Vinnie Scarduzio"; #1240 MLB "Joseph Klein" / "Joe Klein")). Signing status, bonuses and outcomes not researched.
